items.title: Add DONE preflight for main worktree availability before terminal state write
items.context: Move or add a fail-before-write check so story_advance DONE validates main merge target availability, clean state, and merge-tree readiness before writing phase=DONE metadata.
items.userSees: If main is checked out in another worktree or the resolved merge target is unavailable, `lattice story_advance --phase=DONE` fails before phase changes and prints the exact main worktree path or recovery command.

happy.desc: When main merge target is available and clean, DONE transition still completes and cleans story worktree.

edge.desc: When main branch is held by a different registered worktree, story_advance DONE resolves that worktree or fails before writing phase=DONE with a precise message.

adversarial.desc: A failed preflight must leave story phase TEST and must not create partial-DONE metadata or cleanup worktree/branch.

verificationEvidence.note: Build passed and DONE preflight smoke confirms the clean main-on-main happy path still advances to DONE and removes the story worktree/branch.
Smoke covers branch main owned by a separate registered worktree and verifies DONE uses that worktree as the merge target without switching the primary worktree.
Wrong-branch and dirty-main cases fail before phase write; the smoke asserts the story remains TEST and the story worktree/branch survive.

items.title: Teach done_recover and error hints about actual main worktree ownership
items.context: Improve manual recovery guidance so it points to the real main worktree path and does not ask the user to run git merge in a non-main checkout.
items.userSees: Partial-DONE or merge preflight errors show `cd <actual-main-worktree>` before `git merge story/B-xxx`, not an unrelated project root that may be on another branch.

happy.desc: Recovery/preflight guidance includes the actual registered main worktree path when main is not the current root.

edge.desc: Existing done_recover behavior from a normal main root remains unchanged when main is current and clean.

adversarial.desc: Guidance never tells users to merge into a checkout whose current branch is not main.

verificationEvidence.note: DONE and done_recover both resolve the registered worktree that owns branch main when the repository root is on another branch.
done_recover smoke creates a partial-DONE branch, invokes recovery from a non-main root, and verifies merge/cleanup happen through the separate registered main worktree.
Preflight and recovery no longer merge into a non-main checkout; tests verify primary worktree remains on the side branch while the registered main worktree is used.

items.title: Add regression coverage for fail-before-write DONE merge UX
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage around DONE merge preflight and recovery hints, then run build plus flow/process contracts.
items.userSees: Verification transcript includes exact lines such as `DONE main worktree preflight smoke: PASS`, `phase remains TEST after failed preflight`, and `npm --prefix packages/main run build` passing after the fix.

happy.desc: Focused smoke and build pass after the DONE preflight change.

edge.desc: Regression covers multi-worktree main ownership without requiring a destructive real merge into the developer main checkout.

adversarial.desc: Process fact contract remains valid and DONE gate evidence semantics are not downgraded to advisory text.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke and TypeScript build pass on final HEAD 772816b6, including expected PASS lines for happy path and fail-before-write cases.
Existing worktree authority smoke passed on final HEAD, confirming the broader multi-worktree lifecycle behavior was not regressed.
Process fact contract verified after the DONE preflight/recovery change; gate evidence semantics were not downgraded.
